card.label: H.R. 41
card.summary: H.R. 41 recognizes five Southeast Alaska Native communities—Haines, Ketchikan, Petersburg, Tenakee, and Wrangell—which were omitted from eligibility under the original Alaska Native Claims Settlement Act. The bill allows residents of these communities to form urban corporations, receive land entitlements totaling approximately 23,040 acres of surface estate per community, receive subsurface estates through the regional corporation, and establish settlement trusts to support their beneficiaries and cultural heritage.
